extraction.Name: Joseph Dion
extraction.Refused/Protested: I did not want the patent at the time as I was forced to go to war about that time and that it is the cause of losing my place. When I came back I was sick most of the time.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I lost it by mortgage due to the fact that I have been sick nearly ever since I came from the War.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I lost it by mortgage due to the fact that I have been sick nearly ever since I came from the War.
extraction.Occupation/Income: I am not making much of a living but at times I sell cars clothing and such things as I can.
extraction.NOTES: Received patent by mail at Burke, South Dakota in 1918. Got a $6000 mortgage out of it. Has two children. Was gassed and has neuritis; hospitalized on two different occasions. Did not remember signing a receipt for the patent. Notary: S. W. Cross, commission expires 4-28-32.
